page_title: ESP 2-1 RAY | Espanyol v Rayo Vallecano 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card.
90+6' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Walid Cheddira tees up Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top right corner and past Dani Cardenas.
90+3' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
90+3' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.
90+1' Fernando Calero is substituted due to injury. Manolo Gonzalez gives a chance to Sergi Gomez (Espanyol).
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' It doesn’t look good for Fernando Calero (Espanyol); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
85' The referee shows the yellow card to Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol).
85' Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
82' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Having seen unsporting behavior, Adrian Cordero Vega shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is the recipient.
81' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
81' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero Vega has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
76' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Joan Garcia (Espanyol).
75' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' The ball is out of play. Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner.
73' Substitution. Unai Lopez is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
72' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Alvaro Garcia.
71' Today's match ends for Javi Puado who will be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Espanyol).

70' That's unlucky! Alex Kral (Espanyol) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Jofre is replaced by Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol).
63' Here's the change. Jorge de Frutos leaves the pitch and Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
62' Substitution. Sergio Camello did his best and is replaced by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
62' What an opportunity! Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) disappointed the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from inside the box against the crossbar!
61' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Javi Puado, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

57' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
55' A cross from a corner kick by Espanyol is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
52' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that.
50' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Irvin Cardona comes on the pitch for Brian Olivan (Espanyol).
46' The game is over for Jose Gragera (Espanyol). Alvaro Aguado comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
43' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to low to the middle, but Joan Garcia is alert and thwarts the effort.
41' One of the Rayo Vallecano players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
35' Inigo Perez is forced to make a change. Alfonso Espino is unable to continue due to injury, Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
31' Looks like Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
30' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
28' Joan Garcia blocks a long-range effort from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) towards the middle of the goal.
28' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 1:6.
24' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
22' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes.
20' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
15' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero Vega had a clear view and blows his whistle.
15' The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.

14' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
11' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

8' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Jofre, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Carlos Romero (Espanyol), who beats Dani Cardenas with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 1:1.
4' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Adrian Embarba feeds Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the left side of the net.
3' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Adrian Cordero Vega got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
